market.question: Will the highest temperature in Beijing be 23°C on April 27?

assessment.reasoning: Beijing forecast for April 27 2026 shows high around 27°C per multiple aggregators (easeweather, weather25). The market resolves to whichever 1°C bucket contains the daily high; the bucket labeled 23°C (typically 23.0-23.9 °C) is well below the forecast and unlikely. Probability is low but non-zero given forecast uncertainty.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast could be cooler than expected if a cold front passes; specific bucket boundaries depend on Wunderground rounding.
